to: the clients that have the monster, plus the clients in the instance that can see it (`remove_entity_emit`)

fields.name: luckm
fields.description: The luck multiplier of the character that the monster targeted, or 1 when it had no target.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Only for a cooperative monster: the contribution points, keyed by character name (node/server.js:13315).

confirm.note: `id` is `++total_monsters + ""` (node/server.js:13417); `points` is set for every monster (node/server.js:13558) but sent only for a cooperative one

senders.what: `remove_monster` with the default `method: "death"`. Its callers: a kill (`kill_monster`, from `attack`, `skill`, burn and other damage), a pet when its owner disconnects, a `degen` tick, a `temp` monster that the level loop removes, cave actors
